purpose: Read-only DS2 rerun plan. Paths are repository-relative and were checked on 2026-09-24. No model was executed for this registry.
common_prerequisites: A frozen DS2 session manifest, outer TRAIN/validation/test partition, and independent whole-session evaluation bundle.
A declared blind geographic prior that contains the reference site; no reference coordinate in inference tasks.
Receipt-bound causal state caches, TLE archive read access, qualified >=3 s tracks, and a consistent candidate-policy digest.
Randomized within-track TRAIN/held masks only for evaluation; held rows and reference position must not select location, association, or nuisance parameters.
Exact replay gates and machine-readable inference/evaluation artifacts, with failures retained rather than silently dropped.

models.description: Tau-zero full-observation hard Doppler association with one constant CFO per track.
models.scientific_status: Valid reference-free baseline. It must be present in every DS2 comparison.
prerequisites: Common prerequisites only; tau is fixed to zero.
models.notes: Use identical geographic candidates and selected-track denominator for all comparator arms.

models.description: One receive-time shift shared by all scans, tracks, receivers, and satellites in an input bundle; identities and CFOs are reprofiled at every point/tau.
models.scientific_status: Valid nuisance-model comparator. DS1 improved held RMS broadly, but tau may absorb orbit phase and location coupling; do not label it a calibrated clock.
prerequisites: Predeclare tau range/grid and shared scope.
DS2 caches must retain the required receive-time margin for the full tau range.
models.notes: The local-grid implementation in shared_clock_grid is DS1-cohort-specific; use the generic timing worker for DS2.

models.description: One common time term plus shrinkage-regularized per-scan deviations, with association and CFO profiling.
models.scientific_status: Scientifically usable only as a predeclared regularized nuisance comparison. DS1 timing residuals improved, but location benefit was not established as a primary result.
prerequisites: Freeze the deviation prior scale before inspecting DS2 geographic errors.
Report convergence, parameter/guard hits, and comparison to shared-global tau on the same DS2 candidates.
models.notes: Do not choose the regularization scale from DS2 validation/test outcomes.

models.description: Separate tau for every track, with continuous profiling inside a selected time interval.
models.scientific_status: Rejected as a primary position model: DS1 had 3-10% tau-boundary selections and poor transfer. It remains useful to measure timing non-identifiability.
prerequisites: Freeze identities and geographic candidates for the diagnostic.
Report tau-boundary fraction and never use the result as the primary DS2 location.
models.notes: Its freedom can absorb geometric and orbital error track by track.

models.description: One causal TLE-age phase-rate correction per NORAD plus track CFO; hard identities are reacquired during cached geographic screening and final candidates receive exact SGP4 replay.
models.scientific_status: Valid bounded causal nuisance model when exact replay gates pass. It is not a full identity/rate marginalization.
prerequisites: Receipt-bound TLE epochs for each selected NORAD.
Predeclared rate prior/bound and exact-finalist budget.
Pass the 0.2 Hz exact replay gate for every accepted DS2 finalist.
models.notes: Run both rate-only and global-tau-plus-rate forms where the time model is in scope.

models.description: Cache-rate geographic screen with hard reassociation, then exact SGP4 rate audit; rates influence location screening rather than only finalists.
models.scientific_status: Exact gates and causal convention are sound, but DS1-wide geographic claims were development-only. It is a strong DS2 arm if candidate union and exact budget are frozen prospectively.
prerequisites: Fresh DS2 prior search or a predeclared seed union; do not reuse DS1 coordinates.
Cache/tau derivative is screening only; exact replays decide accepted finalists.
models.notes: Retain the matched no-rate baseline so search-model effects are visible.

models.description: Full-observation soft satellite mixture with an unassigned component and per-track CFO; available with fixed tau or shared global tau.
models.scientific_status: Implemented reference-free, but its probabilities are model-dependent rather than calibrated and it lacks a DS1-wide independent positioning qualification.
prerequisites: Use the full causal catalogue and preserve the unassigned component.
Predeclare mixture priors and validate association stability/held behavior before promotion.
models.notes: Soft global-time plus per-NORAD rate is explicitly unsupported and must not be silently approximated.

models.description: One shared receiver coordinate across independent recording groups, with separate group tau, hard association, per-NORAD rates, and track CFOs; equal group objective weights.
models.scientific_status: Reference-free and exact-gated, but DS1 was iterative development on reused groups. DS2 must freeze group composition, weighting, tau grid, search levels, and finalist count before evaluation.
prerequisites: At least two independent whole-session DS2 groups.
A fresh DS2 initial prior/seed policy and equal group weights.
Separate post-seal evaluation; no grid continuation selected from DS2 errors.
models.notes: The shared coordinate is the main route to exploit independent satellite geometries.

models.description: Joint rate-aware search whose proposal and exact stages use the same cap-800 track-weighted loss.
models.scientific_status: Mechanically implemented with tests, but the DS1 artifact is still an uncommitted development arm and its seed set is DS1-specific. Treat it as a prospective DS2 comparator, not an established winner.
prerequisites: Predeclare DS2 seed-generation policy rather than loading iteration-8/9/10 seeds.
Use the same cap, weights, tau shortlist, and exact objective throughout; run its leave-one-scan-out check.
models.notes: This directly tests whether proposal/exact rank mismatch was a DS1 bottleneck.

models.description: One causal rate for a NORAD observed in more than one DS2 group, with group-local CFOs and exact supports.
models.scientific_status: Scientifically valid only when selected DS2 supports have repeated NORADs. DS1's two groups had zero selected NORAD overlap, so its result was a block-diagonal equivalence check.
prerequisites: Choose DS2 groups with repeated selected satellites or report no overlap.
Keep one shared rate keyed only by NORAD and exact replay gates for all groups.
models.notes: Do not spend the fresh-exact-refit budget if overlap is zero.

models.description: Exact causal rate fit plus one common fractional Doppler scale and shrinkage-regularized per-session scale deviations, with track CFOs.
models.scientific_status: The repaired block-coordinate fit converged and cleared guards. It reduced DS1 group losses, but matched rate-only selection chose the same coordinate, so no position-selection benefit is established.
prerequisites: Freeze 500 ppm common/session priors, +/-2000 ppm guard, scalar-rate/scale block stop rule, and local grid before DS2.
Require matched rate-only loss, guard, convergence, and alternate-start diagnostics.
models.notes: Original iteration 6B joint L-BFGS-B is rejected for nonconvergence; use only the repaired runner.

models.description: Fits near-zenith common orientation grid and reports duration-weighted cone quantiles for frozen Doppler identities/locations.
models.scientific_status: Useful for checking whether a DS2 location/association admits a plausible upward-looking mount. It does not itself estimate position or identify RX-to-LNB mapping.
prerequisites: DS2 receiver geometry, provisional RX-to-LNB mapping, ENU conversion, upward tilt bound, and frozen candidate identities/locations.
Report both mapping symmetries and endpoint as well as midpoint coverage.
models.notes: Orientation grid and broad required cones limit its spatial resolving power.

models.description: Optimizes a common constrained mount orientation, applies hard cone support, and refits candidates at fixed positions; compares receiver-label controls.
models.scientific_status: A valid geometry consistency test, not a calibrated antenna or position model. It uses frozen cells and has broad/plateaued orientation optima.
prerequisites: Same geometry prerequisites as pointing-cone quantiles.
Predeclare cone half-angle, orientation grid, all-track unmatched penalty, and mapping-control protocol.
models.notes: The historical fixed-cone widths are half-angles of 10, 15, 20, and 30 degrees, not full FOV values.

models.description: Fixed-position common-orientation association sweep. Implemented full-FOV values are 10, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90 degrees; the earlier compatibility subset is 10, 25, and 30 degrees.
models.scientific_status: Valid support/association sensitivity sweep. Narrow 10-degree full FOV rejected most DS1 duration support; widths are not a calibrated gain model and do not estimate geographic position.
prerequisites: Frozen DS2 positions/identities and complete sampled direction tracks.
Keep all-track unmatched penalties; do not compare supported-only RMS as a position score.
models.notes: Run 10/20/25/30/40/50 first; extend through 90 only as a support diagnostic.

models.description: At every geographic point, fits a constrained common orientation and hard-cone association. Implemented full-FOV variants are 10, 20, 25, 30, 40, and 50 degrees alongside ordinary Doppler.
models.scientific_status: Reference-free local position search is implemented, but every cone-constrained DS1 result was worse than ordinary Doppler. Its current code hardcodes DS1 centers/caches and must be parameterized before DS2.
prerequisites: Parameterize DS2 manifests, blind prior regions, receiver metadata, and cache roots.
Freeze each full-FOV width, 15-degree tilt limit, orientation grid, regional beam, and unmatched-track penalty before execution.
models.notes: Best use is a predeclared geometry stress test alongside the baseline, not the DS2 primary location estimator.

models.description: Gaussian learned-scale and AR(1)+Student-t reranking of fixed exact finalists.
models.scientific_status: DS1 Gaussian rerank retained the rate-only winner; AR(1)+Student-t worsened group 00. Do not make it a primary DS2 arm.
prerequisites: If rerun, freeze finalist set and likelihood hyperparameters before DS2 evaluation.
models.notes: Useful only to diagnose residual correlation after the main exact selection.

models.scientific_status: All DS1 candidates exceeded the function-evaluation limit. No coordinate is portable from this formulation.
prerequisites: None: do not rerun. Use regularized_common_plus_session_scale instead.
models.notes: Kept only for reproducibility of the rejection.

unsupported_combinations.reason: The runner explicitly rejects this combination; it must not be represented as an available DS2 arm.
